cards.text: The LORD of Hosts just finished calling out the priests for despising His name (Malachi 1:6-2:9). Now the prophet Malachi speaks about all of them, himself included. He opens with two easy questions, and friend, when somebody starts with questions you already know the answer to, you can HEAR the "so explain THIS" coming: "Do we not all have one Father? Did not one God create us?"

cards.question: One Father, one God. Yet Malachi asks why his people, himself included, do something to one another. What is it?

cards.text: Breaking faith with one another profanes the covenant of their fathers. Then Malachi drops the questions faster than I drop a hot tray and says it straight: Judah has broken faith, and an abomination has been committed in Israel and in Jerusalem.

cards.question: Malachi says Judah has profaned the LORD's beloved sanctuary. How?

answers.text: By marrying the daughter of a foreign god
By bowing down to the idol of a foreign god
By burning incense to the image of a foreign god

cards.text: Malachi doesn't sugarcoat this one, and I say that as a man who sugarcoats for a LIVING. For the man who does it, he says, may the LORD cut off from the tents of Jacob everyone who is awake and aware.

cards.question: Malachi says the man who marries the daughter of a foreign god is safe, as long as he brings an offering to the LORD of Hosts.

cards.text: Then Malachi says there's "another thing," and friend, whenever anybody says "another thing," I sit down. They cover the altar of the LORD with tears, with weeping and groaning.

cards.question: The people of Judah are covering the LORD's altar with weeping and groaning. Why?

answers.text: The LORD no longer receives their offerings gladly
Their enemies have broken down the city walls
The rain has stopped falling on their fields

cards.text: Yet they ask, "Why?" Friend, that's me pulling raw dough out of a cold oven yelling "WHY?!" when I never even turned it on.
Malachi's answer goes straight home, to the wife of their youth. She's the one they've broken faith with.

cards.question: Malachi answers their "Why?" by saying the LORD has been a witness between each of them and the wife of his youth.
They have broken faith with the wife of their youth. Malachi says she is a man's companion and his wife by ___.

cards.text: Malachi asks if the LORD has not made them one, having a portion of the Spirit, and then he asks, "And why one?" He asks AND answers his own question, and I respect that, friend, because up here nobody else is around to answer mine.

cards.question: Malachi says the LORD made husband and wife one, having a portion of the Spirit. The offspring He seeks from them are ___.
Since the LORD seeks godly offspring, Malachi tells the men they are free to send the wives of their youth away.

cards.text: Malachi tells them to guard themselves in their spirit and not break faith with the wife of their youth. Then the LORD, the God of Israel, speaks for Himself, and friend, I turn the mixer OFF for this one.

cards.question: The LORD, the God of Israel, names one thing He hates. What is it?

cards.text: The LORD of Hosts says the man who divorces his wife covers his garment with violence. Then that line again, guard yourselves in your spirit and do not break faith, and friend, when a line shows up twice in a row, I write it on the inside of my apron.
